integrity: Conditional norm identity, exact coupling parameterization, stable-step quartic and optimal-rate inequalities proved analytically; standalone rational tests are supplemental. Independent expert audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Two equally likely positive scalar bilinear components, equal-stage steps, iid iteration pairs and zero additive noise; mean-square only. Extension to multi-component, nonlinear or general bilinear matrix cases is unproved.
title: A sharp two-oracle coupling phase transition for bilinear stochastic extragradient
